'''Tamaav''' will be one of the Clan Chiefs seen in one of [[Aviendha]]'s visions of the future in the [[Glass columns]] ''ter'angreal'' in [[Rhuidean]], 

He will live twenty years after the Seanchan gained the Andoran war machines. He tells the others in the meeting of the survivors of the [[Council of Twenty Two]] that the [[White Tower]] has fallen. When they are discussing what to do, he says that surrender would make them ''[[gai'shain]]'', meaning without honour, and asks [[Ladalin]] for her advice.
